def validate_regon(regon: str) -> bool:
    if not regon.isdigit() or len(regon) != 9:
        return False
    weights = [8, 9, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
    digits = [int(d) for d in regon]
    sum_val = sum(d * w for d, w in zip(digits[:8], weights))
    remainder = sum_val % 11
    checksum = 0 if remainder == 10 else remainder
    return checksum == digits[8]
